```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022)) |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rank_changes
```


```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank, year) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_prefix = "rank_"
  ) |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = abs(rank_2015 - rank_2022),
    release_decade = (year %/% 10) * 10
  )

rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(
    average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)
  ) |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```


```{r}
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

tryCatch({

  response <- request(snapshot_urls[1]) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  imdb_2015 <- resp_body_html(response) |>
    html_elements("table") |>
    html_table() |>
    purrr::pluck(1) |>
    select(1, 2)

  print(imdb_2015)

}, error = function(e) {
  message("The Wayback Machine request failed: ", e$message)
  message("Keep using the existing imdb_snapshots dataset.")
})
```
